name: sentia
description: Editor-native AI agent layer that brings a codebase to life.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:editor-client && npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n protocol,webview,extension,sidecar -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix packages/protocol run dev" "npm --prefix apps/webview run dev" "npm --prefix apps/extension run dev" ".venv/bin/sentia-sidecar"
scripts.lint: npm run build:protocol && eslint apps packages && .venv/bin/ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/protocol run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/editor-client run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/webview run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/extension run typecheck && .venv/bin/mypy apps/sidecar/src
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.test:js: npm --prefix packages/protocol test && npm --prefix apps/webview test && npm --prefix apps/extension test
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
